name: Segmented control
description: A row of joined segments for choosing one option from a small set, such as List or Grid view. Build it from radio inputs in a <fieldset> so it behaves like a Radio group.
summary: Pick one of a few options in a joined row

elements.name: Label
elements.description: Legend naming the choice; can be visually hidden if the context is clear

elements.name: Segment
elements.description: One option, with text, an icon or both

elements.name: Selected segment
elements.description: Exactly one segment is selected and shown filled

configOptions.options: Text, Icon only, Icon and text

variants.caption: Icon only — view switcher
variants.htmlOutline:
<fieldset class="segmented">
  <legend>View</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="view" checked aria-label="List"> <svg aria-hidden="true">…</svg></label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="view" aria-label="Grid"> <svg aria-hidden="true">…</svg></label>
</fieldset>

variants.caption: Full width — equal segments across the container
Visible label — legend above the segments

usageNotes: Use it for two to five short, mutually exclusive options. With more options or long labels, use a Radio group or a Select.

Radio inputs give the expected keyboard behavior for free: one tab stop, with arrow keys moving the selection. If you build it from buttons instead, follow the ARIA Authoring Practices radio group pattern.
If each option shows a different panel of content, use Tabs. A Segmented control changes a value or a view setting.
Icon-only segments need an accessible name each. Show the selected segment with more than a color change, and give it 3:1 contrast against the others (WCAG 1.4.1, 1.4.11).
htmlOutline:
<fieldset class="segmented">
  <legend>View</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="view" checked> List</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="view"> Grid</label>
</fieldset>
